Author: JustPixelll
Name: Should I Sell?
Punchline: Know what to sell, how much, and for how much.
Description: Analyze every known marketable item you own using live FFXIV Market Board data, Universalis history, supply and demand, stack behavior, vendor economics and after-tax value. Get sell ratings, suggested prices and stack sizes, full live audits, current-listing guidance, and recommended-listing payout estimates.
Changelog:
Initial public release of Should I Sell?

Highlights:
- 1-5 star sell ratings plus strict 0-100 opportunity score
- Suggested executable Market Board price
- Suggested stack size and low-maintenance alternative
- Recommended-listing after-tax payout
- Gold highlighting for already-listed owned items
- Current Listings audit with expected payout and repricing guidance
- Full live audit across known owned items
- Universalis history integration
- Vendor buyback and gil-shop economics
- Sortable/filterable tables, item details and clipboard price shortcut

Requires Dalamud API 15.
